title: Meridian Lab-Grown Diamond Riviere Necklace
descriptionHtml:
The riviere is the piece jewellery houses save for the top shelf: a single unbroken river of stones, each one set by hand in its own four-prong crown. The Meridian is that piece — made honest. Uniform round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, graded D–F colour and VS clarity or better, run across the front and sides of the necklace, finished with a mirror-polished link section at the back so it drapes flat and sits comfortably against the collarbone.

Choose 2.00, 3.00 or 5.00 total carats of lab-grown diamonds. A natural-stone riviere like this would run well into five figures; ours doesn’t, because lab-grown diamonds cost radically less to grow than natural diamonds cost to mine — identical in composition, hardness and fire. We pass that difference straight to you, at a fair price we never inflate and never discount.

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • 2.00 ctw (110 stones, 1.7 mm) / 3.00 ctw (100 stones, 2.0 mm) / 5.00 ctw (100 stones, 2.4 mm)
  • Individual four-prong crown settings; polished oval-link back section for comfort and drape
  • Length 16 in / 40.5 cm; made-to-order 15–18 in on request at no charge
  • Box clasp with figure-eight safety catch
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before swimming, showering and workouts; apply perfume before you dress; wipe with the soft cloth included and store in your [BRAND] pouch.

Certified, not claimed. Your Meridian ships with its own IGI finished-jewellery report verifying the total carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) of its lab-grown diamonds — verifiable any time at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Your riviere is set, polished and quality-checked after you order, and ships in approximately 7 days with tracked express delivery. No overproduction, no inflated markup.

title: Dawn Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Studs
descriptionHtml:
Every jewellery box is built on one pair of solitaire studs — the earrings that work at 7 am and 11 pm, with everything, forever. Dawn is that pair, done properly. Each stud holds a round brilliant lab-grown diamond, hand-matched to its partner for size and brightness, graded D–F colour and VS clarity or better.

Lab-grown diamonds are real in every measurable way — grown above ground instead of mined, which is the only reason a pair like this can cost hundreds instead of thousands. The low-profile martini basket keeps each stone close to the ear, so it sits flat and catches light from every angle. Choose 0.30 total carats of lab-grown diamonds for everyday polish, 0.50 for the classic, or 0.75 when you want the first thing people notice to be your ears.

  • Matched pair of round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • Per pair: 0.30 ctw (3.4 mm) / 0.50 ctw (4.1 mm) / 0.75 ctw (4.7 mm)
  • Four-prong martini basket setting, low profile
  • Double-notched posts with secure push backs
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before swimming, showering and workouts; keep perfume and hairspray off the metal; store in your [BRAND] pouch between wears.

Certified, not claimed. Dawn ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report verifying the carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) of your lab-grown diamonds — verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Your studs are set, matched and quality-checked after you order, and ship in approximately 7 days with tracked delivery. No warehouse stock, no overproduction, no inflated markup.

title: Nova Lab-Grown Diamond Bezel Studs
descriptionHtml:
The bezel is the setting for women who don’t babysit their jewellery. A seamless rim of polished metal wraps each round brilliant lab-grown diamond completely — nothing to snag on knitwear or hair, no prongs to check. It’s the most secure way to set a stone, and the most quietly modern.

Each Nova stud carries a lab-grown diamond graded D–F colour and VS clarity or better, hand-matched as a pair. The bright metal rim reads as part of the stone, so each earring wears visually larger than its carat weight. Choose 0.20 total carats of lab-grown diamonds for a clean, minimal dot of light, or 0.50 total carats for full presence. Both sit flush and low on the ear — comfortable under headphones and helmets.

  • Matched pair of round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • Per pair: 0.20 ctw (3.0 mm stones) / 0.50 ctw (4.0 mm stones)
  • Full bezel setting, seamless polished rim; face-up look ~4.2 mm / ~5.2 mm
  • Double-notched posts with secure push backs; flush, low-profile fit
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before water and workouts, keep cosmetics off the metal, and store in your [BRAND] pouch.

Certified, not claimed. Nova ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report confirming the carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) of your lab-grown diamonds — verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Each pair is set and quality-checked after you order and ships in approximately 7 days with tracked delivery. Making to order is how we avoid overproduction — and how the price stays fair.

title: Ember Lab-Grown Diamond Pavé Huggies
descriptionHtml:
Huggies are the hardest-working earrings you’ll own — the pair that goes in and simply stays. Ember earns that permanent spot with a face of micro-pavé lab-grown diamonds, each tiny stone set by hand under a jeweller’s microscope so the front of the hoop is an unbroken line of light.

Every stone is a genuine lab-grown diamond, D–F colour, VS clarity or better — the same grading standard as our statement pieces, because a small stone is not an excuse for a lesser one. The hoops are hollow-formed for lightness, hug the lobe closely, and close with a firm click of the hinged post. Choose 11 mm for a tight hug, 13 mm for a touch more presence — or both, because huggies were born to stack.

  • Micro-pavé round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • Per pair: 11 mm (16 stones, 0.15 ctw) / 13 mm (20 stones, 0.30 ctw)
  • Hollow-form 2 mm tube; hinged click-snap post closure
  • Front-face pavé, hand-set under magnification
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before swimming, showering and the gym, and store in your [BRAND] pouch overnight.

Certified, not claimed. Even our smallest stones are graded: Ember ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report verifying the total carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) of its lab-grown diamonds — verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Your huggies are set and quality-checked after you order and ship in approximately 7 days with tracked delivery. No stockpiles, no overproduction, no inflated price.

title: Comet Lab-Grown Diamond Drop Huggies
descriptionHtml:
Some earrings sit still. Comet doesn’t. From a clean, polished huggie swings a single bezel-set lab-grown diamond that moves when you move — turning your head, laughing, talking with your hands. Every movement catches light, which is exactly the point.

Each drop is a round brilliant lab-grown diamond, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, wrapped in a smooth bezel that lets it swing freely without ever feeling fragile. Choose 0.20 total carats of lab-grown diamonds for a delicate flicker, or 0.40 total carats when you want the room to notice. The 12 mm huggie closes with a hinged click and sits snug to the lobe, so all the drama stays in the drop — structured enough for a 9 am meeting, alive enough for candlelight.

  • Bezel-set round brilliant lab-grown diamond drop on each ear, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • Per pair: 0.20 ctw (3.0 mm drops) / 0.40 ctw (3.8 mm drops)
  • 12 mm polished huggie hoop; hinged click-snap post closure
  • Free-swinging bezel drop for movement and light
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before water and exercise, keep perfume off the metal, wipe gently after wear and store in your [BRAND] pouch.

Certified, not claimed. Comet ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report verifying the carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) of its lab-grown diamonds — verifiable at igi.org.

title: Aria Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Pendant
descriptionHtml:
One stone, one fine chain, nothing to hide behind — the solitaire pendant is jewellery’s simplest sentence, which is why the stone has to be excellent. Aria’s is: a round brilliant lab-grown diamond graded D–F colour and VS clarity or better, held in a four-prong basket that lifts it just off the skin so light enters from every side.

A lab-grown diamond is real — the same crystal, hardness and fire as a natural diamond — grown above ground in weeks rather than mined over millennia. That’s the entire reason Aria can put a visibly half-carat-plus stone at your collarbone for under $400. Choose 0.30 carats for everyday delicacy, 0.50 for the classic, or 0.75 for presence you can see across a room. The fine cable chain adjusts from 16 to 18 inches, so it layers cleanly with everything.

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamond, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • Centre stone options: 0.30 ct (4.3 mm) / 0.50 ct (5.1 mm) / 0.75 ct (5.8 mm)
  • Four-prong basket setting
  • 1.1 mm cable chain, adjustable 16–18 in / 40.5–45.5 cm, lobster clasp
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before swimming and showering, spritz perfume before you put it on, and let the chain rest flat in your [BRAND] pouch overnight.

Certified, not claimed. Aria ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report verifying your lab-grown diamond’s carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) — verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Your pendant is set, polished and quality-checked after you order, and ships in approximately 7 days with tracked delivery. We make exactly what’s ordered — nothing more — and price it fairly because of that.

title: Vesper Lab-Grown Diamond East-West Pendant
descriptionHtml:
Turn an emerald cut on its side and something interesting happens: it stops being traditional and starts being a point of view. Vesper sets a half-carat emerald-cut lab-grown diamond east-west — horizontally — in a sleek bezel on a fine paperclip chain: a classic you haven’t seen before.

Emerald cuts don’t sparkle like rounds; they flash. Long, stepped facets create the “hall of mirrors” effect — broad planes of light that read calm, deliberate, expensive. Ours is a genuine lab-grown diamond, D–F colour, VS clarity or better, its clean geometry framed by the polished bezel so the profile stays razor-thin against the skin. Step-cut stones this clear are usually the preserve of four-figure price tags; growing the stone above ground instead of mining it is what puts Vesper at $315. Wear it alone at 16 inches, or layer it under our Aria solitaire at 18.

  • Emerald-cut lab-grown diamond, 0.50 ct (6 x 4 mm), D–F colour, VS clarity or better, IGI-certified
  • East-west (horizontal) full-bezel setting; slim profile
  • Fine paperclip chain, 18 in / 45.5 cm, fastens at 16 in; lobster clasp
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+

Caring for vermeil: remove before water and workouts, keep lotions off the chain, and store flat in your [BRAND] pouch.

Certified, not claimed. Vesper ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report verifying your emerald-cut lab-grown diamond’s carat weight, colour range (D–F) and clarity (VS+) — verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Your Vesper is set, polished and quality-checked after you order, shipping in approximately 7 days with tracked delivery. Made to order, made without waste, priced without games.

title: Heirloom Natural Diamond Halo Pendant
descriptionHtml:
Everything else we make celebrates the lab-grown diamond. This piece honours the original. The Heirloom is the single natural-diamond design in our collection — one deliberate exception, clearly labelled, for the moments that call for a stone the earth made first.

At its centre sits a natural diamond, mined not grown: a round brilliant of 0.40 or 0.50 carats, G–H colour, SI1 clarity, individually certified by IGI with its own natural diamond report. Around it, a halo of twelve smaller natural diamonds widens the face-up look to that of a far larger solitaire. Every stone in this pendant is a natural diamond — it contains no lab-grown stones. Some occasions — a landmark birthday, a christening, something meant to be handed down with its certificate — carry a weight of tradition that calls for a natural stone. We simply insist you know exactly what you’re buying, and pay a fair, transparent price for it.

  • Centre: natural diamond (mined), round brilliant, G–H colour, SI1 clarity, IGI-certified — 0.40 ct (4.8 mm) or 0.50 ct (5.1 mm)
  • Halo: 12 natural diamonds, ~0.10 ctw — natural diamonds only, no lab-grown stones
  • Total weight ~0.50 / ~0.60 tcw; face-up spread ~8.0–8.4 mm
  • Four-prong centre, shared-prong halo; 1.2 mm cable chain, adjustable 16–18 in, lobster clasp
  • 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+
  • Special Collection: the only natural-diamond piece in the [BRAND] line

Caring for vermeil: remove before swimming and showering, keep perfume off the piece, and store it in its [BRAND] case with its certificates.

Doubly certified. Your Heirloom ships with two IGI documents: an IGI natural diamond report for the centre stone — confirming it is a natural, mined stone of the stated weight, colour and clarity — and an IGI finished-jewellery report covering the complete pendant, halo included. Both verifiable at igi.org.

Made to order, just for you. Each Heirloom is set around its individually certified natural diamond after you order, and ships in approximately 7 days with tracked, signature-required express delivery.
